comments.body:
PR: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/874

Please see the questions listed in the comment to the PR.

This change will likely have implications for any project that inherits directly from the `fcrepo` POM. I can confirm that the message-consumer will need to be updated (there is a dependency conflict with joda-time)
Related PR for message consumer: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-message-consumer/pull/93
PR has been updated to address code comments

Some follow-on PRs:
